class|Path of Elementalism|9|Infernal El: Effect: You learn two Attacks from the Tier 1 Dark or Fire Elementalist Attack List. At Level 5, learn two more from the Tier 1 or 2 list. At Level 10, learn two more from the Tier 1, 2 or 3 List.
class|PTE Rule Book|139|Acrobat: Effect: You gain an Evasion Token. Bonus: You start the Scene with 1 Evasion Token (Max 3). You may expend any number of Evasion Tokens when you’re hit by a non-Adjacent Damaging Attack to downgrade it. If it was a Critical Hit, it is instead a normal hit. If it was a normal hit, you resist it an additional step. If you resisted it, it instead misses. You cannot use Evasion Tokens if you have Damage Reduction from any Item you’re holding or equipping.
class|PTE Rule Book|94|Alchemist:
Effect: Choose any “Basic Potion” Item. You may instead choose a “Greater Potion” Item if you have at least 4 Alchemist Features. Then apply any Effect below:
» You create the chosen Item and it is added to your Inventory, however, it is destroyed at the end of the Scene. 
» One Item in your Inventory that matches the declared Item cannot miss when next used with a Throw Maneuver.
class|PTE Rule Book|95|Apothecary:
Condition: You’re in an area with floral life
Effect: You gain 2 Simple Poultice. If you have Expert Nature Edu, you instead gain 2 Greater Poultice or 3 Simple Poultice. Bonus: You gain the Herb Crafter Talent, even if you don’t qualify for it. Your “Poultice” Items are treated as “Healing Potions” for the sake of Triggers and Effects from Medicine Researcher.
class|PTE Rule Book|109|Artificer: Effect: You create a Shard and add it to an open Inventory Slot. If used as a Swift Action, its color is chosen instead of randomized. If used as a Free Action, it is randomized as normal. Artificer may only be used once per Round. Bonus: You gain the Artificing Kit and grant it the [Trinket] Keyword. During Crafting Downtime Actions you may create Type Augmentors, Type Boosters and Type Braces. Each Shard you have can be used as if they were 5 “Ingredient” Items for Artificer Recipes, however their associated Type must match the crafted Item.
class|PTE Rule Book|135|Artillerist:
Target: A Ranged Blast Attack, Line Attack or a Damaging 1-Target Attack on your Attack list. 
Effect: While this Feature is Bound, the Targeted Attack’s Range improves. If it was a 1-Target Attack, it becomes Ranged Blast 2. If it was Ranged Blast, increase its Area of Effect by +1. If it was Line, increase its Area of Effect by +2. X is equal to the number of Artillerist Features you have.
class|PTE Rule Book|144|Assassin:
Target: An Enemy you can see 
Effect: The Target makes an Intuition or Perception Check opposed by your Combat or Stealth. If they fail, they become Marked with your Death Mark. Whenever you use an Attack with its only Target having your Death Mark, Enemies other than the Target cannot Trigger Reactions against it.
class|PTE Rule Book|130|Aura Guardian: Effect: Choose two of Aura Blast, Detect, Force Bullet, or Vacuum Wave. You learn the chosen Attacks. When you have 4 Aura Guardian Features, choose two of Aura Burst, Aura Sphere, Focus Blast or Heal Pulse. You learn the chosen Attacks.
class|PTE Rule Book|105|Battle Specialis:
Target: A Pokemon you have used a Training Downtime Action this Scene and an Attack they know
Effect: The Targeted Attack becomes their Signature Attack. Refer to the next page for details on how to create a Signature Attack. A Pokemon may only have one Attack learned this way at a time. The points budget for this Attack is equal to the number of Battle Specialist Features you have. If the Targeted Pokemon isn’t owned by you, their points budget cannot exceed 2 points used.
class|PTE Rule Book|125|Berserker:
Trigger: You’re hit with an Attack or hit a Damaging Attack
Effect: After the Triggering Attack resolves, you gain a Fury Counter (Max 6). Bonus: For each Fury Counter you have, your Critical Hit Range is increased by +1. Whenever you land a Critical Hit, all Fury Counters are expended. You learn the Rage Attack.
class|PTE Rule Book|71|Bug Specialist:
Target: Your Pokemon with a Bug Type Attack
Effect: Choose an Adaptation Technique to apply to the Targeted Pokemon which they benefit from while this Feature is Bound. Your Pokemon can only have one Adaptation at a time.
» Adaptation Techniques are on the next Page
class|PTE Rule Book|121|Bulwark: Effect: You create Large Blocking or Cover Terrain in up to 3 unoccupied adjacent spaces. Terrain Created this way is also [Fragile & Breakable]. Whenever you or an Ally are adjacent to this Terrain, they have Damage Reduction equal to your Tier Value (This does not stack with itself). If you have 4 Bulwark Features you may use this as a Swift or Movement Action as well, but only choose 1 unoccupied adjacent space instead.
class|PTE Rule Book|91|Chronicler: Effect: Whenever you use the Analyze Maneuver on a Pokemon or Trainer and pass its associated Skill Check (If any), they become Studied.If you would need to make a Skill Check for an Analyze Maneuver that isn’t a Chronicler Skill, you may add 2d6 to the roll, but it cannot exceed 6d6 this way.
class|PTE Rule Book|52|Commander:
Trigger: You use an Order
Effect: One Target of the Triggering Order gains a Rallied Coat. A Rallied Coat can be expended as a Swift Action before the user rolls a d20 to add a d4 Modifier to it. At Tier 3, this upgrades to a d6. Commander can only be used once per Round. Bonus: You gain the Battle Commander General Feature, ignoring Prerequisites.
class|PTE Rule Book|114|Coordinator:
Trigger: You use a Downtime Training Action on your Pokemon 
Effect: Choose an Attack on each of your Trained Pokemon and choose an Innovation Technique that corresponds to your Coordinator Style and whose Prerequisites are met. Whenever they use that Attack as a Standard Action, they gain the benefits of that Technique. A Pokemon may only be affected by one Innovation Technique at a time.
Note: When you gain this Feature, choose a Coordinator Style. Coordinator Styles are Beauty, Cool, Cute, Smart, Tough. When you have 4 Coordinator Features, you may select another Style to gain. Coordinator Skills are Charm, Command or Poke Edu
class|PTE Rule Book|140|Dancer: Effect: Choose two Basic Dance Technique to learn. All Dance Techniques performed by you or your Pokemon can only Target the same Combatant once per Round.
class|PTE Rule Book|117|Daredevil:
Trigger: You perform a non-Education Skill Check 
Effect: Add 2d6 to the Skill Check. If you don’t exceed the required Successes by at least 1, it is treated as a Critical Failure instead. If the Triggering Skill Check is for a non- Questing Downtime Action, roll a Luck Check instead and on a 15 or less, you suffer a minor setback regardless of the result. If it was 5 or less, it is instead a major setback. Bonus: You may gain Adrenaline Tokens as a result of your Actions.
class|PTE Rule Book|73|Dark Specialist: Effect: Your Pokemon have a bonus to Accuracy equal to your Tier Level if the Target is Flanked, Drowsy, Slowed, Suppressed, Tripped, Weakened or Vulnerable. If the Attack is Dark Type and they gain this bonus, they also have a bonus to Effect Ranges equal to your Tier Level.
class|PTE Rule Book|149|Debonair: Effect: You learn the Cute Charm Ability. Whenever you Entrance an Enemy that is already Entranced, they become Coerced.
class|PTE Rule Book|120|Defender: Effect: When using the Defend Maneuver, you may Target any number of Adjacent Allies to benefit from its Effect. You may learn two Attacks from the Defensive Combat Feature’s Novice Attack List.
class|PTE Rule Book|74|Dragon Specialist: Effect: Your Pokemon may become Enraged as a Swift Action. Whenever your Pokemon are Enraged, they cannot become Provoked. While your Pokemon are Enraged, their Dragon Type Attacks have their Area of Effects increased by +1. If an Attack would be 1-Target, it may become Blast 2 instead of having its Area of Effect increased.
class|PTE Rule Book|58|Duelist:
Target: An Enemy within 10m
Effect: The Target becomes Marked with a Tagged Mark. The Tagged Mark has no effect other than applying to the Momentum Counter Mechanic.
class|PTE Rule Book|75|Electric Speciali: Effect: Your Pokemon’s Damaging Electric Type Attacks gain a 18+ Effect Range to cause their Targets to become Paralyzed if they don’t have one already. If they already have one, it is increased by +1. Whenever your Pokemon use a Damaging Attack against a Paralyzed Enemy, they cannot resist it.
class|PTE Rule Book|131|Empath:
Target: A Creature within 20m
Effect: While a Target is bound by this Feature they become Channeled by you. If the Target is unwilling you must make an Intuition Checks opposed by their Focus Check to Bind this Feature to them. You may stop Channeling any Target as a Free Action at any time. If a Channeled Combatant would go further than 20m away from you they stop being Channeled. You are always considered a Channeled Combatant. You may only use this Feature on an Enemy once per Round. X is equal to the higher of your Intuition or Occult Edu Rank. Bonus: You gain the Empath Capability.
class|PTE Rule Book|133|Esper: Effect: Choose two of Cognition Strike, Hypnosis, Psybeam, or Psychic Terrain. You learn the chosen Attacks. When you have 4 Esper Features, choose two of Psycho Cut, Psychic, Psychic Storm or Psionic Surge. You learn the chosen Attacks.
class|PTE Rule Book|76|Fairy Specialist:
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Fairy Type Attack or your Fairy Type Pokemon use a Status Category Attack 
Effect: A Fairy Light is summoned in an Adjacent, unoccupied space. If the Triggering Attack’s Accuracy Roll was a Natural 15+ and/or if it was a Status Attack used as a Standard Action, one more Fairy Light is Summoned. If the Triggering Attack didn’t have an Accuracy Check, you may perform a Luck Roll instead. Bonus: Fairy Lights may be expended to grant the Target a Tick of Temporary Hit Points which may stack on existing Temp HP.
class|PTE Rule Book|124|Fighter: Effect: Choose a Stat to become your Trained Stat (You can only have one at a time). Your Trained Stat has their Default CS Value set to +1. If you chose HP, you instead start the Scene with 2 Ticks of Temporary Hit Points. Bonus: You may learn two Attacks from the Martial Combat Feature’s Novice Attack List.
class|PTE Rule Book|77|Fighting Speciali:
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit with a Melee or Fighting Type Damaging Attack on a single Target
Effect: The Target becomes Marked with an Adversary Mark. Bonus: Your Pokemon’s Fighting Type Damaging Attacks have a bonus to Damage Rolls equal to your Tier Value and a bonus to their Accuracy Rolls equal to your Tier Level. These bonuses only apply if the only Target is an Enemy with the Adversary Mark.
class|PTE Rule Book|78|Fire Specialist: Effect: Your Pokemon’s Damaging Fire Type Attacks gain a 18+ Effect Range to cause their Targets to become Burned. If they already have a Burn Effect Range, it is increased by +2. Whenever a Fire Hazard or your Pokemon Burn a Target that is already Burned, they lose a Tick of HIt Points and gain +1 Combustion Counter (Max 3). Whenever a Burned Combat with a Combustion Counter would cure the Burned Affliction, they instead remove a Combustion Counter.
class|PTE Rule Book|79|Flying Specialist: Effect: Your Pokemon gain the Quick Capability. Your Flying Type Pokemon may use the Disengage Maneuver as a Swift Action as well as a Movement Action and when they do, they may move 3m instead of 1.
class|PTE Rule Book|90|General Researche: Effect: You may Rank up two different Skills you’re able to upgrade. Whenever you make a Skill Check for an Education Skill other than General Edu, you may add 1d6 to the roll. When you reach Expert Gen Edu, instead add 2d6. You cannot exceed 6d6 this way.
class|PTE Rule Book|107|Geneticist:
Target: Two willing Pokemon
Effect: Choose one Target to become the Donor, the other being the Recipient. Choose an Effect granted by the Bonus of one of this Class’s Features to apply to the Targets. Abilities or Attacks granted this way cannot be Signature, Innate or originally gained as a result of this Feature. Pokemon may only be the Recipient Target of this Feature once, or up to twice if owned by you. If a Pokemon not owned by you benefits from this Feature, they can no longer equip Items. Changes made through this Feature are not considered “Natural”. Bonus: When using the Geneticist Feature, you can choose an Attack that Donor knows that matches a Type of the Recipient. Add that Attack to the Recipient’s corresponding Tutor List. If the Recipient’s Type would change in the future, they lose any Attacks that no longer match.
class|PTE Rule Book|80|Ghost Specialist:
Effect: Whenever your Pokemon use a Ghost Type Attack, you gain 1 Curse Token (Max 6) after Attack resolution. Your Pokemon may use a Standard Action, or a Free Action upon Fainting, to expend any amount of Curse Tokens to apply conditions to an Enemy within 5m of them listed below at their listed cost:
» 1 Curse Token: The Target becomes Suppressed
» 2 Curse Tokens: The Target becomes Cursed or loses -3 CS in a Stat of your Choice
» 3 Curse Tokens: The Target has one Stat of your choice lowered to -2 CS
» 4 Curse Tokens: The Target becomes Drowsy and cannot be cured through sources other than a Save Check.
class|PTE Rule Book|126|Gladiator:
Trigger: You Provoke an Enemy, land a Critical hit, an Attack misses you, or you or your Pokemon cause an Enemy to faint 
Effect: You gain +1 Glory Counter. For each Glory Counter you have, you have a +1 Modifier to Accuracy for Melee Attacks. Whenever your Pokemon Faint, you lose half of your Glory Counters (Rounded Down). You cannot have more Glory Counters than double your Tier Level. Bonus: You learn the Taunt Attack.
class|PTE Rule Book|81|Grass Specialist:
Trigger: You use a Downtime Action to Train your Pokemon
Target: Your Trained Pokemon and a Grass Type Status Attack on their Battle or Known Attack List
Effect: The Targeted Attack no longer takes an Attack Slot and is always on their Battle Attack List. A Pokemon can only have one Attack affected by this Feature at a time; if a new Attack is chosen for the Targeted Pokemon, the previous one loses this Effect.
class|PTE Rule Book|82|Ground Specialist:
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Ground Type Attack 
Effect: After the Attack’s resolution, create a 3x3 Zone that includes one Target of the Triggering Attack. Spike Hazards are created in Spaces in this Zone. If the Triggering Pokemon has the Groundshaper Capability, they may use it on any number of spaces in this zone as a Free Action.
class|PTE Rule Book|136|Gunslinger:
Effect: Whenever you use a 1-Target Ranged Attack, you have a bonus to Accuracy equal to X subtracted by Y (Even if it’s Range would change as a result of a Feature). X is equal to the higher of your Acrobatics or Intuition Rank. Y is equal to the distance in Meters the Target is away from you.
Notet: If the result is negative, you don’t have a penalty, simply no modifier.
class|PTE Rule Book|99|Herbalist: Effect: You gain the Seed Bag Item and it gains the [Trinket] Keyword and is always treated as Equipped. If it were to occupy an Equipment Slot despite having the [Trinket] keyword, you have a bonus to Accuracy equal to your Tier Level for Attacks provided by it and the Herbalist Class.
class|PTE Rule Book|101|Hex Maniac:
Trigger: An Enemy within 5m misses an Attack
Effect: The Target gains a Hexed Coat. While they have this Coat each time they fail a Save Check, they have their Stat with the highest CS lowered by -2 CS. (Choose on tie) Bonus: Choose two Attacks to learn. When you have 5 Hex Maniac Features, you learn the ones you didn’t choose.
» Confuse Ray, Curse, Haunting Aura, Malice
class|PTE Rule Book|53|Hunter: Effect: You and your Pokemon learn the Pack Hunt Ability. You gain the Battle Commander General Feature, ignoring Prerequisites.
class|PTE Rule Book|83|Ice Specialist: Effect: Your Pokemon’s Ice Type Attacks inflict the Chilled Affliction on an 18+ or increase existing Chilled Effect Ranges by +2. Whenever your Pokemon would cause a Chilled Pokemon to become Chilled again, they gain a Permafrost Coat. Whenever an Enemy with a Permafrost Coat is hit by a Damaging Attack, it automatically becomes a Critical hit, then the Coat is expended.
class|PTE Rule Book|118|Imposter: Effect: You gain the Makeshift Artisan Talent. You may craft [Small] and [Large] Disguises. You learn the Copycat Attack.
class|PTE Rule Book|110|Jailbreaker:
Target: A Pokeball you or an Ally owns with a Captured Pokemon inside. 
Effect: Assign a Pokeball Modification from the list below to the Target which applies to the captured Pokemon while this Feature is bound to it. A Target can only be affected by one Pokeball Modification at a time. X is equal to the higher of your Poke Edu or Tech Edu Rank. Bonus: You gain the Ball Crafter Talent even if you do not qualify. If you already have the Ball Crafter Talent or gain it in the future, you may also craft the Protoball Item for $100 per.
class|PTE Rule Book|122|Juggernaut: Effect: You gain +5 Stat Points in HP. When you have 3 Juggernaut Features, you gain an additional +5. When you have 5 Juggernaut Features, you gain an additional +10. Stat Points gained this way go in the Extras Column. You start the Scene with a Tick of Temporary Hit Points.
class|PTE Rule Book|134|Marksman:
Trigger: You miss a 1-Target Ranged Attack 
Effect: Your next 1-Target Ranged Attack gains all of the following benefits upon the Attack’s declaration.
» It gains a bonus to Critical Hit Ranges equal to your Tier Level.
» Targets may only apply Speed Evasion against it.
» It gains the Unstoppable Keyword.
class|PTE Rule Book|59|Mastermind: Effect: Your Pokemon may use the Help Maneuver or use Attacks through the Versatile Keyword even if they used a Damaging Attack this Round. Additionally, they are not restricted from using Damaging Attacks if they did perform one of these Actions during their Turn.
class|PTE Rule Book|93|Medicine Research: Effect: Whenever you Use or Throw a Basic Healing Potion, you ignore the following restriction: “A Combatant cannot be Targeted by a Healing Potion more than once per Scene”. When you have at least 4 Medicine Researcher Features, this also extends to Greater Healing Potions.
class|PTE Rule Book|127|Monk:
Trigger: You start your Turn 
Effect: Choose a Stance below to enter. You benefit from the Stance’s effects until you enter a new stance or the Scene ends. 
» Ferocious Stance - You have a bonus to the Damage Rolls for Melee Attacks equal to your Tier Value.
» Defensive Stance - You have Damage Reduction against Physical Attacks equal to your Tier Value
» Flowing Stance - Your Movement Value is increased by +3 and you do not provoke Attacks of Opportunity by moving.
» Meditative Stance - You have a bonus to Save Checks and Evasion equal to your Tier Level.
class|PTE Rule Book|54|Motivator:
Target: Up to three Allied Combatants
Effect: The Targets gain a Motivated Coat. Bonus: You gain the Battle Commander General Feature, ignoring Prerequisites
class|PTE Rule Book|92|Musician: Effect: You create a Zone of Song in a Burst 2 range centered on you. When the Zone is created, choose a song below to apply to all listed Combatants within this Zone. A Combatant cannot benefit from multiple Zones of Song. The chosen song can be changed as a Free Action at the start of your Turn. Whenever you use a Reaction, this Zone is removed.
class|PTE Rule Book|128|Mystic: Effect: You learn two Basic Weapon Attacks with the Requirement of [Arcane] Only or two Attacks from the Psionic Combat Features’ Novice Attack List or one Attack from each list. When you have 4 Mystic Features, you learn two more from the Advanced Weapon list with the same requirement or from the Psionic Combat Features Expert Attack List. Weapon Attacks learned this way can be used through a qualifying Weapon as if it was granted through them or as if the Weapon Range was 6 and usable without a Weapon.
class|PTE Rule Book|96|Nature Researcher: Effect: When you gain this Feature, you gain the Naturewalk Capability with a Terrain of your choice. While you’re in Terrain that matches one of your Naturewalks, you gain a bonus to Accuracy Rolls equal to your Tier Level. (This bonus does not stack with itself)
class|PTE Rule Book|145|Ninja:
Effect: Choose a Ninja Specialty listed below. You then gain the associated Capabilities of that specialty.
» The Path of Deception - Blender & Illusionist
» The Path of Psionics - Pick two of Aura Reader, Mindlock, Telekinetic, Telepath & True Sight 
» The Path of Shadows - Dead Silent, Darkvision, Shadow Meld
» The Path of Tradition - Climber, Jumper & Quick
Note: Ninja Skills are Acrobatics, Guile, Intimidate or Stealth
class|PTE Rule Book|98|Nomad: Effect: While you’re in Terrain that matches one of your Naturewalk Capabilities, you cannot become Slowed or Tripped. You gain 2 Inventory Slots and another 2 when you have 3 Nomad Features and another 2 when you have 5 Nomad Features. You cannot have more than 12 total Inventory Slots.
class|PTE Rule Book|84|Normal Specialist: Effect: Your Pokemon’s Normal Type Attacks have a Damage Bonus equal to your Tier Value. Whenever your Pokemon use a Normal Type Attack as a Standard Action, they gain Damage Reduction equal to your Tier Value until the end of the next Round. Damage Reduction gained this way cannot stack with itself.
class|PTE Rule Book|100|Occult Researche: Effect: Upon gaining this Feature, choose a [Class] Feature that has Occult Researcher as a Prerequisite and you gain it as a Bonus Feature, becoming your Linked Class. When Features in a Linked Class refer to a Skill, you may replace it with Occult Education. Example: Empath’s Twisted Emotions can be taken with Novice Occult Edu instead of Intuition. Using the Empath Feature may use Occult Education instead of Intuition vs their Focus.
class|PTE Rule Book|64|Officer:
Target: Your Companion 
Effect: While Bound, the Companion becomes a Battle Companion. If they were to gain Initiative, you may expend any number of unused Trainer Actions for them to use, otherwise they cannot use Actions. When you Faint, this Feature is unbound and they lose their Companion Title. X is equal to your Tier Level. Bonus: You gain a Ranger Styler.
class|PTE Rule Book|65|Operator: Effect: While your Ranger Styler occupies an Equipment Slot, it is treated as a Simple, Short Ranged Martial Weapon. Its qualifying skill is Technology Education. At Tier 2, it improves to Fine Quality and at Tier 3, it improves to Legendary Quality. You may choose the granted Attacks but it does not get Keywords. Bonus: You gain a Ranger Styler.
class|PTE Rule Book|112|Performer:
Trigger: You or your Pokemon hit a Super Effective Attack, hit a Scene x1 Attack, use the Intercept Maneuver or use the Riposte Maneuver
Effect: Gain 1 Flair Token. This Feature is a Free Action when Triggered but may also be used as a Swift Action, ignoring the Trigger. If this is used as a Swift Action, instead gain 2 Flair Tokens. Bonus: You may spend Flair Tokens up to your Tier Level to add an equal amount to You or Your Pokemon’s Effect Range until the end of their next turn as an At-Will Free Action. 
Note: Performer Skills are Acrobatics, Charm, Focus or Guile
class|PTE Rule Book|85|Poison Specialist: Effect: Your Pokemon’s Damaging Poison Type Attacks gain a 18+ Effect Range to cause their Targets to become Poisoned. If they already have a Poisoned Effect Range, it is increased by +2. Whenever a Hazard or your Pokemon Poison a Target that is already Poisoned, they gain +1 Venom Counter (Max 3). Whenever a Poisoned Combatant with a Venom Counter would cure the Poisoned Affliction, they instead remove a Venom Counter.
class|PTE Rule Book|104|Pokemon Research: Effect: When interacting with Pokemon, you may add a bonus to the Skill Check depending on your Poke Edu Rank. If it is Adept or under, roll +1d6 more. If it is Expert or higher, roll +2d6 more. You cannot exceed (6d6) this way and this does not apply to Poke Edu Skill Checks.
class|PTE Rule Book|148|Provocateur:
Trigger: You hit a Social Attack or Manipulate Maneuver
Effect: One Enemy hit by the Triggering Attack or Maneuver has a penalty to all Accuracy Rolls and Save Checks equal to your Tier Level until the end of their next Turn. Provocateur can only be used once per Round. Bonus: You may learn two Attacks from either the Alluring Combat Feature or Imposing Combat’s Novice Attack List, or a combination of either.
class|PTE Rule Book|86|Psychic Specialis:
Target: A Pokemon you own and a Psychic Status Attack currently on their Battle Attack List 
Effect: While this Feature is bound, you have the chosen Attack added to your Attack List.
class|PTE Rule Book|62|Ranger: Effect: You gain the Ranger Styler Item and it gains the [Trinket] Keyword and is always treated as Equipped. If it were to occupy an Equipment Slot despite having the [Trinket] Keyword, you may instead use its Effects as a Standard or Swift Action, but an Enemy can only be affected by your Styler once per Round. Additionally, when using a Styler, you may use any Ranger Skill for the Opposed Skill Check.
class|PTE Rule Book|67|Rider: Effect: Your Pokemon are all treated as having the Mountable Capability. When Mounting a Pokemon, it may be performed as a Free Action instead of a Swift Action. While you are Mounted, you and your Mount each use the highest of each other’s Evasion when either are Targeted by an Attack.
class|PTE Rule Book|87|Rock Specialist:
Trigger: You use a Downtime Action to Train your Pokemon 
Target: Your Trained Pokemon 
Effect: The Target learns the Stealth Rock Attack, even if they normally can’t learn it. If the Target is Rock Type, the Attack doesn’t take an Attack Slot on their Battle Attack List. Your Pokemon may treat the Stealth Rock attack as if it were EOT Frequency instead of Scene x2.
class|PTE Rule Book|143|Rogue:
Trigger: You hit a Damaging Attack against an Adjacent Enemy 
Effect: After the Attack’s Resolution, you may perform a Manipulate or Tactic Maneuver against one Target of the Triggering Attack as a Free Action, excluding Attack of Opportunity or Throw. Bonus: You may learn two Attacks from the Criminal Combat Feature’s Novice Attack List.
class|PTE Rule Book|151|Ruffian:
Trigger: You hit an Attack or Maneuver
Effect: One Target of the Triggering Attack or Maneuver loses -1 CS in a Stat of your choice. If the Triggering Attack was a Social Attack, it affects all Targets instead. A Combatant may only be affected by this Feature once per Round.
class|PTE Rule Book|103|Sage:
Trigger: You or an Ally within 5m would take Damage 
Effect: Expend an Action listed below and apply its effects to all Combatants hit by the Triggering Attack:
» Standard - All Targets resist the Triggering Attack by an additional damage step 
» Swift or Reaction - They gain Damage Reduction against it equal to your Tier Value. If you expend both a Swift and Reaction, it is instead double your Tier Value.
class|PTE Rule Book|123|Sentinel:
Trigger: You use Damaging Attack against an Enemy that is Provoked by you or an Attack of Opportunity
Effect: If the Triggering Attack is Physical, you use your Defense as the Offensive Stat instead of Attack. If the Triggering Attack is Special, you use your Special Defense as the Offensive Stat instead of Special Attack. Bonus: When your Attack of Opportunity is Triggered, you may use a Swift Action or a Reaction to use it. An Enemy can only Trigger your Attack of Opportunity once per Round.
class|PTE Rule Book|68|Signer:
Target: A Pokemon with significant power that you have at least a Trusted Bond with 
Effect: The Target becomes your Guardian for the duration they are bound by this Feature. Bonus: You may communicate with your Guardian(s) as if you had the Telepath and Empath Capability, regardless of your current distance from them. X is equal to your Tier Level.
class|PTE Rule Book|142|Skirmisher:
Trigger: You use a Damaging Attack 
Effect: After the Triggering Attack resolves, you may Disengage as a Free Action. Bonus: Whenever you use the Disengage Maneuver you may instead move a number of spaces equal to half the higher of your Acrobatics or Combat Rank.
class|PTE Rule Book|137|Sniper: Effect: This Feature can be used as a Swift Action, Movement Action or Reaction. Each time this Feature is used, add an Accuracy and Critical Hit modifier to your next Ranged Attack equal to your Tier Level. These bonuses are removed at the end of the Round.
class|PTE Rule Book|60|Stat Ace:
Effect: Choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, Speed or HP to become your linked Stat. Your Pokemon gain the Ability listed in parenthesis next to your Linked Stat.
» Attack (Huge Power), Defense (Stoicism), Special Attack (Sorcery), Special Defense (Mysticism), Speed (Alacrity), HP (Abominable)
class|PTE Rule Book|88|Steel Specialist: Effect: Non-Adjacent Attacks have a penalty to their Critical Hit Range, Effect Range and Accuracy Rolls against your Steel Type Pokemon equal to your Tier Level. Your Pokemon have a bonus to Effect Ranges for their Steel Type Attacks equal to your Tier Level.
class|PTE Rule Book|55|Strategist:
Trigger: A Round Starts
Effect: Create a 3x3 Observation Zone on the Field that lasts until the end of the Round. You may use Basic Orders on Allies within this Zone as a Free Action. A Combatant can only be affected by an Order used this way once per Round. Bonus: You gain the Battle Commander General Feature, ignoring Prerequisites
class|PTE Rule Book|138|Strider: Effect: Enemies cannot Trigger Reactions as a result of your Movement. You may learn two Attacks from the Nimble Combat Feature’s Novice Attack List.
class|PTE Rule Book|146|Swashbuckler: Effect: Your Damaging Attacks have a 12+ Effect Range to grant you a Panache Coat. This Effect Range cannot be extended like normal Effect Ranges.
class|PTE Rule Book|61|Taskmaster: Effect: Your Pokemon gain the listed benefits if their Current HIt Points are lower than the following HP Thresholds. 75% - +2 Modifier to Accuracy Rolls and Save Checks 50% - +5 to Damage Rolls and +5 Damage Reduction. These become +10 if you have 5 Taskmaster Features. 25% - +2 Modifier to Critical Hit Ranges and Effect Ranges. 0% - All the previous values are doubled.
class|PTE Rule Book|108|Tech Researcher: Effect: Choose any Capability listed under the Innovative Gadgets Feature. You gain a custom Item with the [Trinket] Keyword that grants the chosen Capability. Others cannot benefit from this Item.
